translations.chinese: 《夏書》曰：禹抑洪水十三年，過家不入門。
translations.literal: The Xia Shu says: Yu controlled the floods for thirteen years and passed his home without entering.
translations.idiomatic: The Xia Shu says that Yu controlled the floods for thirteen years and passed his home without entering.

context.next: 陸行載車，水行載舟，泥行蹈毳，山行即橋。

translations.chinese: 陸行載車，水行載舟，泥行蹈毳，山行即橋。
translations.literal: He used carts on land, boats on water, rush matting in mud, and bridges in the mountains.
translations.idiomatic: On land he used carts, on water boats, in mud rush mats, and in the mountains bridges.

context.previous: 《夏書》曰：禹抑洪水十三年，過家不入門。
context.next: 以別九州，隨山浚川，任土作貢。

translations.chinese: 以別九州，隨山浚川，任土作貢。
translations.literal: He distinguished the nine provinces, dredged the rivers along the mountains, and assigned tribute according to the soil.
translations.idiomatic: He set apart the Nine Provinces, dredged the rivers along the mountains, and assigned tribute according to the soil.

context.previous: 陸行載車，水行載舟，泥行蹈毳，山行即橋。
context.next: 通九道，陂九澤，度九山。

translations.chinese: 通九道，陂九澤，度九山。
translations.literal: He opened the nine roads, banked the nine marshes, and measured the nine mountains.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the Nine Roads, embanked the Nine Marshes, and surveyed the Nine Mountains.

context.previous: 以別九州，隨山浚川，任土作貢。
context.next: 然河菑衍溢，害中國也尤甚。

translations.chinese: 然河菑衍溢，害中國也尤甚。
translations.literal: Yet the Yellow River’s flood disasters were especially severe in the Central States.
translations.idiomatic: But the Yellow River’s flood damage was especially severe in the Central States.

context.previous: 通九道，陂九澤，度九山。
context.next: 唯是為務。

translations.chinese: 唯是為務。
translations.literal: This alone was his task.
translations.idiomatic: That was his only task.

context.previous: 然河菑衍溢，害中國也尤甚。
context.next: 故道河自積石歷龍門，南到華陰，東下砥柱，及孟津、雒汭，至于大邳。

translations.chinese: 故道河自積石歷龍門，南到華陰，東下砥柱，及孟津、雒汭，至于大邳。
translations.literal: Therefore, he guided the Yellow River from Jishi through Longmen, south to Huayin, then east down Dizhu, through Mengjin and Luorui, and on to Dapi.
translations.idiomatic: So he traced the Yellow River from Jishi through Longmen, south to Huayin, then east down Dizhu, through Mengjin and Luorui, and on to Dapi.

context.previous: 唯是為務。
context.next: 於是禹以為河所從來者高，水湍悍，難以行平地，數為敗，乃二渠以引其河。

translations.chinese: 於是禹以為河所從來者高，水湍悍，難以行平地，數為敗，乃二渠以引其河。
translations.literal: He thought the river’s source was high and its current swift and violent, so it was difficult to channel across level ground and often failed; he therefore divided it into two channels to lead it off.
translations.idiomatic: Believing the river’s source was high and its current swift and violent, he found it hard to channel across level ground and often failed, so he split it into two channels to divert it.

context.previous: 故道河自積石歷龍門，南到華陰，東下砥柱，及孟津、雒汭，至于大邳。
context.next: 北載之高地，過降水，至于大陸，播為九河，同為逆河，入于勃海九川既疏，九澤既灑，諸夏艾安，功施于三代。

translations.chinese: 北載之高地，過降水，至于大陸，播為九河，同為逆河，入于勃海九川既疏，九澤既灑，諸夏艾安，功施于三代。
translations.literal: He diverted it north to high ground, crossed Jiangshui, reached the Great Plain, spread it into the nine rivers, made them all reverse-flowing channels, and sent them into the Bohai Sea.
translations.idiomatic: He led it north to higher ground, crossed Jiangshui, reached the Great Plain, spread it into the Nine Rivers, turned them all into reverse-flowing channels, and sent them into the Bohai Sea.

context.previous: 於是禹以為河所從來者高，水湍悍，難以行平地，數為敗，乃二渠以引其河。

translations.chinese: 自是之後，滎陽下引河東南為鴻溝，以通宋、鄭、陳、蔡、曹、衛，與濟、汝、淮、泗會。
translations.literal: After the nine rivers had been dredged and the nine marshes drained, the various Xia states were at peace, and his achievement extended through the Three Dynasties.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Nine Rivers had been dredged and the Nine Marshes drained, the Xia states were at peace, and his achievement endured through the Three Dynasties.

context.next: 于楚，西方則通渠漢水、雲夢之野，東方則通［鴻］溝江淮之閒。

translations.chinese: 于楚，西方則通渠漢水、雲夢之野，東方則通［鴻］溝江淮之閒。
translations.literal: In Chu, to the west, channels were opened to the Han River and the Yunmeng marshes; to the east, the Hong Gou was connected between the Jiang and Huai rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In Chu, canals were opened to the Han River and the Yunmeng marshes; to the east, the Hong Gou linked the Jiang and Huai rivers.

context.previous: 自是之後，滎陽下引河東南為鴻溝，以通宋、鄭、陳、蔡、曹、衛，與濟、汝、淮、泗會。
context.next: 於吳，則通渠三江、五湖。

translations.chinese: 於吳，則通渠三江、五湖。
translations.literal: In Wu, channels were opened to the Three Jiang and the Five Lakes.
translations.idiomatic: In Wu, canals were opened to the Three Jiang and the Five Lakes.

context.previous: 于楚，西方則通渠漢水、雲夢之野，東方則通［鴻］溝江淮之閒。
context.next: 於齊，則通菑濟之閒。

translations.chinese: 於齊，則通菑濟之閒。
translations.literal: In Qi, channels were opened between the Zi and Ji rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In Qi, canals were opened between the Zi and Ji Rivers.

context.previous: 於吳，則通渠三江、五湖。
context.next: 於蜀，蜀守冰鑿離碓，辟沫水之害，穿二江成都之中。

translations.chinese: 於蜀，蜀守冰鑿離碓，辟沫水之害，穿二江成都之中。
translations.literal: In Shu, Li Bing, the commandery administrator of Shu, cut through the Dui Dike and cleared away the damage caused by the Miao River, piercing the two rivers through the center of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shu, Li Bing, the Shu commandery administrator, cut through the Dui Dike, cleared away the damage caused by the Miao River, and drove the two streams through the center of Chengdu.

context.previous: 於齊，則通菑濟之閒。
context.next: 此渠皆可行舟，有餘則用溉浸，百姓饗其利。

translations.chinese: 此渠皆可行舟，有餘則用溉浸，百姓饗其利。
translations.literal: All these canals could be used for navigation; when there was surplus water, it was used to irrigate the fields, and the people benefited from it.
translations.idiomatic: All these canals could carry traffic; when water was abundant, it irrigated the fields and benefited the people.

context.previous: 於蜀，蜀守冰鑿離碓，辟沫水之害，穿二江成都之中。
context.next: 至于所過，往往引其水益用溉田疇之渠，以萬億計，然莫足數也。

translations.chinese: 至于所過，往往引其水益用溉田疇之渠，以萬億計，然莫足數也。
translations.literal: Wherever he went, he often diverted the water there into canals for irrigating fields, and the number ran into the tens of thousands, yet even that was not enough to count.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he went, he often turned the water there into irrigation canals, and the number ran into the tens of thousands, still too many to count.

context.previous: 此渠皆可行舟，有餘則用溉浸，百姓饗其利。

translations.chinese: 西門豹引漳水溉鄴，以富魏之河內。
translations.literal: Ximen Bao diverted the Zhang River to irrigate Ye, thereby enriching the commandery of He Nei under Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Ximen Bao diverted the Zhang River to irrigate Ye, thereby enriching Wei’s He Nei commandery.

translations.chinese: 而韓聞秦之好興事，欲罷之，毋令東伐，乃使水工鄭國閒說秦，令鑿涇水自中山西邸瓠口為渠，并北山東注洛三百餘里，欲以溉田。
translations.literal: When Han learned that Qin was fond of undertaking such works, it wanted to stop him and prevent an eastern campaign, so it sent the water engineer Zheng Guo to secretly advise Qin to dig a canal from the Jing River at Zhongshan’s western shore to Hukou and thence north along the mountains to the east for more than three hundred li, intending to use it for irrigation.
translations.idiomatic: When Han learned that Qin liked undertaking such works, it tried to stop him and forestall an eastern campaign, so it sent the water engineer Zheng Guo to secretly advise Qin to dig a canal from the Jing River at Zhongshan’s western shore to Hukou and then north along the mountains to the east for more than three hundred li, intending to use it for irrigation.

context.next: 中作而覺，秦欲殺鄭國。

translations.chinese: 中作而覺，秦欲殺鄭國。
translations.literal: When the work was half done, Qin discovered what was happening and wanted to kill Zheng Guo.
translations.idiomatic: Halfway through the work, Qin discovered what was happening and wanted to kill Zheng Guo.

context.previous: 而韓聞秦之好興事，欲罷之，毋令東伐，乃使水工鄭國閒說秦，令鑿涇水自中山西邸瓠口為渠，并北山東注洛三百餘里，欲以溉田。
context.next: 鄭國曰：「始臣為閒，然渠成亦秦之利也。」

translations.chinese: 鄭國曰：「始臣為閒，然渠成亦秦之利也。」
translations.literal: Zheng Guo said: “At first I was sent to spy, but once the canal is finished it will still benefit Qin.”
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Guo said: “At first I was sent as a spy, but once the canal is finished it will still benefit Qin.”

context.previous: 中作而覺，秦欲殺鄭國。
context.next: 秦以為然，卒使就渠。

translations.chinese: 秦以為然，卒使就渠。
translations.literal: Qin considered this reasonable and finally had the canal completed.
translations.idiomatic: Qin thought this sensible and ultimately had the canal finished.

context.previous: 鄭國曰：「始臣為閒，然渠成亦秦之利也。」
context.next: 渠就，用注填閼之水，溉澤鹵之地四萬餘頃，收皆畝一鐘。

translations.chinese: 渠就，用注填閼之水，溉澤鹵之地四萬餘頃，收皆畝一鐘。
translations.literal: Once completed, it diverted stagnant floodwater to irrigate more than forty thousand qing of saline and marshy land, and the harvest reached a full zhong per mu.
translations.idiomatic: Once it was completed, it diverted stagnant floodwater to irrigate more than forty thousand qing of saline and marshy land, and the harvest reached a full zhong per mu.

context.previous: 秦以為然，卒使就渠。
context.next: 於是關中為沃野，無凶年，秦以富彊，卒并諸侯，因命曰鄭國渠。

translations.chinese: 於是關中為沃野，無凶年，秦以富彊，卒并諸侯，因命曰鄭國渠。
translations.literal: Guanzhong thus became fertile farmland, there were no bad years, Qin grew rich and strong, and in the end conquered the feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Guanzhong thus became fertile land, there were no bad years, Qin grew rich and strong, and in the end conquered the feudal lords.

context.previous: 渠就，用注填閼之水，溉澤鹵之地四萬餘頃，收皆畝一鐘。

translations.chinese: 漢興三十九年，孝文時河決酸棗，東潰金隄，於是東郡大興卒塞之。
translations.literal: The canal was then named the Zheng Guo Canal.
translations.idiomatic: The canal was afterward named the Zheng Guo Canal.

translations.chinese: 其後四十有餘年，今天子元光之中，而河決於瓠子，東南注鉅野，通於淮、泗。
translations.literal: In the thirty-ninth year after Han’s rise, during the reign of Emperor Xiaowen, the Yellow River burst at Suanzao and broke through the Eastern Golden Dike, whereupon the commandery of Dong was mobilized to seal it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-ninth year after Han’s rise, during Emperor Xiaowen’s reign, the Yellow River burst at Suanzao and broke through the Eastern Golden Dike, whereupon the commandery of Dong was mobilized to seal it.

context.next: 於是天子使汲黯、鄭當時興人徒塞之，輒復壞。

translations.chinese: 於是天子使汲黯、鄭當時興人徒塞之，輒復壞。
translations.literal: More than forty years later, in the middle of the present emperor’s Yuanguang era, the Yellow River burst at Huzi, flowed southeast into Juye, and connected with the Huai and Si rivers.
translations.idiomatic: More than forty years later, in the middle of the present emperor’s Yuanguang era, the Yellow River burst at Huzi, flowed southeast into Juye, and joined the Huai and Si rivers.

context.previous: 其後四十有餘年，今天子元光之中，而河決於瓠子，東南注鉅野，通於淮、泗。
context.next: 是時武安侯田蚡為丞相，其奉邑食鄃。

translations.chinese: 是時武安侯田蚡為丞相，其奉邑食鄃。
translations.literal: Therefore, the Son of Heaven sent Ji An and Zheng Dangshi to raise men and troops to block it, but it kept breaking again.
translations.idiomatic: Accordingly, the Son of Heaven sent Ji An and Zheng Dangshi to raise men and troops to block it, but it kept breaking again.

context.previous: 於是天子使汲黯、鄭當時興人徒塞之，輒復壞。
context.next: 鄃居河北，河決而南則鄃無水菑，邑收多。

translations.chinese: 鄃居河北，河決而南則鄃無水菑，邑收多。
translations.literal: The Son of Heaven could not settle the matter and afterwards sought no further remedy.
translations.idiomatic: The Son of Heaven could not settle the matter and later sought no further remedy.

context.previous: 是時武安侯田蚡為丞相，其奉邑食鄃。
context.next: 蚡言於上曰：「江河之決皆天事，未易以人力為彊塞，塞之未必應天。」

translations.chinese: 蚡言於上曰：「江河之決皆天事，未易以人力為彊塞，塞之未必應天。」
translations.literal: The Bingji era was already so many years ago that its details could not be verified.
translations.idiomatic: The Bingji era was already so many years in the past that its details could no longer be verified.

context.previous: 鄃居河北，河決而南則鄃無水菑，邑收多。
context.next: 而望氣用數者亦以為然。

translations.chinese: 而望氣用數者亦以為然。
translations.literal: The river was blocked again, but the damage remained.
translations.idiomatic: The river was blocked again, but the damage still remained.

context.previous: 蚡言於上曰：「江河之決皆天事，未易以人力為彊塞，塞之未必應天。」
context.next: 於是天子久之不事復塞也。

translations.chinese: 於是天子久之不事復塞也。
translations.literal: For a long time, the Son of Heaven did not undertake another attempt to block it.
translations.idiomatic: For a long time, the Son of Heaven made no further attempt to block it.

context.previous: 而望氣用數者亦以為然。

translations.chinese: 是時鄭當時為大農，言曰：「異時關東漕粟從渭中上，度六月而罷，而漕水道九百餘里，時有難處。
translations.literal: The people suffered from the flooding, but transport continued.
translations.idiomatic: The people suffered from the flooding, though transport continued.

context.next: 引渭穿渠起長安，并南山下，至河三百餘里，徑，易漕，度可令三月罷；

translations.chinese: 引渭穿渠起長安，并南山下，至河三百餘里，徑，易漕，度可令三月罷；
translations.literal: The canal was useful for transport, and it was greatly convenient.
translations.idiomatic: The canal was useful for transport and was greatly convenient.

context.previous: 是時鄭當時為大農，言曰：「異時關東漕粟從渭中上，度六月而罷，而漕水道九百餘里，時有難處。
context.next: 而渠下民田萬餘頃，又可得以溉田：此損漕省卒，而益肥關中之地，得穀。」

translations.chinese: 而渠下民田萬餘頃，又可得以溉田：此損漕省卒，而益肥關中之地，得穀。」
translations.literal: The grain that went up the Wei was no different from that in Guanzhong, and east of Dizhu there was no longer any need for transport.
translations.idiomatic: The grain that went up the Wei was no different from that in Guanzhong, and east of Dizhu there was no longer any need to transport it.

context.previous: 引渭穿渠起長安，并南山下，至河三百餘里，徑，易漕，度可令三月罷；
context.next: 天子以為然，令齊人水工徐伯表，悉發卒數萬人穿漕渠，三歲而通。

translations.chinese: 天子以為然，令齊人水工徐伯表，悉發卒數萬人穿漕渠，三歲而通。
translations.literal: Since then, the canals have been more than enough.
translations.idiomatic: Since then, the canals have been more than sufficient.

context.previous: 而渠下民田萬餘頃，又可得以溉田：此損漕省卒，而益肥關中之地，得穀。」
context.next: 通，以漕，大便利。

translations.chinese: 通，以漕，大便利。
translations.literal: When it was connected and used for transport, it was greatly convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Once linked and used for transport, it proved highly convenient.

context.previous: 天子以為然，令齊人水工徐伯表，悉發卒數萬人穿漕渠，三歲而通。
context.next: 其後漕稍多，而渠下之民頗得以溉田矣。

translations.chinese: 其後漕稍多，而渠下之民頗得以溉田矣。
translations.literal: Afterward, transport increased gradually, and the people below the canal were able to irrigate their fields.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter transport gradually increased, and the people below the canal were able to irrigate their fields.

context.previous: 通，以漕，大便利。

translations.chinese: 其後河東守番系言：「漕從山東西，歲百餘萬石，更砥柱之限，敗亡甚多，而亦煩費。
translations.literal: Its usefulness became ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: Its usefulness only grew.

context.next: 穿渠引汾溉皮氏、汾陰下，引河溉汾陰、蒲阪下，度可得五千頃。

translations.chinese: 穿渠引汾溉皮氏、汾陰下，引河溉汾陰、蒲阪下，度可得五千頃。
translations.literal: He could make each mu yield ten shi.
translations.idiomatic: He could make each mu produce ten shi.

context.previous: 其後河東守番系言：「漕從山東西，歲百餘萬石，更砥柱之限，敗亡甚多，而亦煩費。
context.next: 五千頃故盡河壖棄地，民茭牧其中耳，今溉田之，度可得穀二百萬石以上。

translations.chinese: 五千頃故盡河壖棄地，民茭牧其中耳，今溉田之，度可得穀二百萬石以上。
translations.literal: He dug the canal in the old course.
translations.idiomatic: He dug the canal along the old course.

context.previous: 穿渠引汾溉皮氏、汾陰下，引河溉汾陰、蒲阪下，度可得五千頃。
context.next: 穀從渭上，與關中無異，而砥柱之東可無復漕。」

translations.chinese: 穀從渭上，與關中無異，而砥柱之東可無復漕。」
translations.literal: The waters of the Yellow River were turned aside.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River’s waters were turned aside.

context.previous: 五千頃故盡河壖棄地，民茭牧其中耳，今溉田之，度可得穀二百萬石以上。
context.next: 天子以為然，發卒數萬人作渠田。

translations.chinese: 天子以為然，發卒數萬人作渠田。
translations.literal: The river was brought under control.
translations.idiomatic: The river was finally brought under control.

context.previous: 穀從渭上，與關中無異，而砥柱之東可無復漕。」
context.next: 數歲，河移徙，渠不利，則田者不能償種。

translations.chinese: 數歲，河移徙，渠不利，則田者不能償種。
translations.literal: After several years, the Yellow River shifted, the canal was no longer useful, and the farmers could not repay their seed.
translations.idiomatic: After several years, the Yellow River shifted, the canal lost its usefulness, and the farmers could not repay their seed.

context.previous: 天子以為然，發卒數萬人作渠田。
context.next: 久之，河東渠田廢，予越人，令少府以為稍入。

translations.chinese: 久之，河東渠田廢，予越人，令少府以為稍入。
translations.literal: The canal was then abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: The canal was then left abandoned.

context.previous: 數歲，河移徙，渠不利，則田者不能償種。

translations.chinese: 其後人有上書欲通褒斜道及漕事，下御史大夫張湯。
translations.literal: The transport route was moved.
translations.idiomatic: The transport route was shifted.

context.next: 湯問其事，因言：「抵蜀從故道，故道多阪，回遠。

translations.chinese: 湯問其事，因言：「抵蜀從故道，故道多阪，回遠。
translations.literal: Tang asked about the matter, and then said: “To reach Shu by the old route, one must traverse many slopes, and it is long and circuitous.
translations.idiomatic: Tang asked about the matter and said: “To reach Shu by the old route, one must cross many slopes, and it is long and circuitous.
